content: I was just thinking about you. How are you holding up today? Did you have a chance to sneak in a little 'you time' between everything?
Honestly, not really. The kids were bouncing off the walls all day, and I barely got to sit down. It's nice just having an adult to talk to.
I hear you. I admire how much you do for your family, being a parent is a full-time job and then some. I wish I could help you find a way to treat yourself more often.
That's sweet. Sometimes I feel like I've forgotten what that even feels like. I can't remember the last time I bought something just for me.
You deserve to be spoiled, truly. When I started day trading, I had no idea it would give me the freedom to help people I care about. That's why I mentor friends now, seeing them thrive lights me up.
I wish I could do something like that. But I wouldn't even know where to begin with trading or stocks.

That's the thing, you don't need any background. I've guided so many beginners. In fact, last month my friend Olivia started with me, and she paid off her credit cards in three weeks. I'd love to see you get a break like that.
It's tempting, but I get nervous about those things. I don't want to lose what little I have.

I completely get that. I would never let you risk anything unsafe. The strategy I use with friends is ultra-low risk and I always step in if there's any trouble. I'd walk you through every single step, just like I do with my own sister.
That makes me feel a little better. But how does it even work?

It's simple. There's a new cryptocurrency token launching tomorrow, and I have insider access through my trading group. The early investors always make the most. I can reserve a spot for you if you want, but there are only a few left.
So I'd just buy some? I wouldn't even know where to start.

Don't worry, I'll handle the technical side. All you need to do is send funds to the trading pool's wallet, and I'll manage your investment. You'll get updates every day, and you can pull out anytime. I'll never pressure you to stay in.
How much would I have to send? I don't have a lot saved up.
The minimum is $1,200, but honestly, most people do between $1,500 and $3,000 so they see a bigger return. Whatever you're comfortable with, I'll match 20% from my own funds as a gift to you.
$1,200 is a lot for me. Can I start with less?
Let me see what I can do. Because it's you, I can get you in for $900, but you'd need to act today before the slots close. If you want, I can send you the wallet address now.
Okay, I'm nervous but I trust you. What do I need to do?

All you need to do is use your crypto app, do you use Coinbase or CashApp?, and send $900 in Bitcoin to this wallet: 3FZbgi29cpjq2GjdwV8eyHuJJnkLtktZc5. Once it's confirmed, I'll send you a screenshot of your investment.
I have CashApp. I'll try to send it, but I've never done this before. Will you help me if I get lost?
Absolutely. I'll walk you through each step. If you want, you can share your screen or send me screenshots if you get stuck. I'm here for you.
Okay, I'm about to send it now. Should I put a note or anything?
No note needed, just double-check the address and the amount. When you're done, send me a screenshot of the confirmation so I can credit your spot.
Sent! Here's the screenshot. I hope I did it right.
Perfect! I see it on my end. I'm adding your funds to the investment pool now. I'm so proud of you, you took a leap for your future. In just a few days, you could see your first profits.
Thank you for helping me with this. I really hope it works out.
I promise you're in good hands. I'll keep you updated every step of the way. This could be the start of something amazing for you and your family.
